items.name: Abridge
items.note: Epic-centred ambient scribe. Strongest evidence-linking story; dual output of clinical note plus patient summary; expanding into coding review.

items.name: Dragon Copilot (formerly DAX)
items.note: Broadest enterprise EHR coverage (Epic, Oracle Health, Meditech) with Dragon dictation.

items.name: Nabla
items.note: Multilingual and telehealth-friendly; pre-charting, coding and decision support; many EHR integrations.

items.name: Heidi
items.note: Customizable templates, voice commands, adapts to clinician style; builds documents from audio, PDF, Word and images.

items.name: Freed
items.note: Setup in minutes for solo and small clinics; browser-based EHR push; 14 languages.

items.name: Mentalyc
items.note: Each note builds on prior sessions; drafts treatment plans with SMART goals, tracks progress, flags risk, notes per group member; deletes audio once the note is ready.

items.name: Upheal
items.note: Live and post-session notes, built-in consent flows, session analytics such as talk ratios, telehealth and EHR in one tool.

items.name: Clio Manage AI (formerly Duo)
items.note: Practice-management AI: matter summaries, client emails, deadline extraction to calendar, time entries and billing narratives; tenant-isolated.

items.name: Jump
items.note: Meeting prep and follow-up, CRM sync (Wealthbox, Redtail, Salesforce), customizable templates with summary verification; its bot joins the call.

items.name: Zocks
items.note: Never stores audio; extracts structured facts, fills forms, tracks consent, archives to compliance systems.

added.how: Before recording, Verity shows facts from approved records only — last values, open promises — each with its source document.
Name every participant before consent, add guests (family, interpreter). Labels carry into transcript and audit.
Capture in person, from a call, by phone or upload. Calls are captured on the Mac without a bot joining; language is auto-detected or chosen.
Extracted fields, each with source and status, mapped to EHR / CRM / matter fields. Sent only after approval; undocumented fields are skipped.
Compares only values stated in both sessions — no inferred trends. Talk time is framed for self-review, not as a score.
Consent, capture, AI draft, edits, verifications, addenda, approval and delivery — exportable.
Add what you observed but didn’t say. Marked as dictated so it’s never mistaken for recorded evidence.
Patient summary in Spanish, with a warning that a qualified speaker should review it before sending.
Record systems per profession, botless video capture, calendar and tasks, plus a plain-language compliance panel.
Suggests rules from your repeated corrections. Nothing changes until you add the rule to the template.
added.where: Output Studio → Learned from your edits

added.how: Legal gets a time entry and deadline on the calendar; medical gets tasks and a review visit; consulting gets Jira items.

standards.req: Session details: date, start/end time, modality, client + second identifier, provider credentials, CPT
Separate client report (quoted) from clinician observation; mental-status findings only when observed
Golden thread — name the treatment-plan goal addressed and progress
standards.where: Goals addressed + Goal 2 progress in Assessment

standards.req: Same content in SOAP, DAP, BIRP, GIRP formats
Pre-sign review checklist; objective, non-judgmental language
Addendum with audit trail — never edit a finalized note; label late entries
standards.where: Signed notes read-only · late-entry addendum · Audit

standards.req: Psychotherapy notes kept separate from progress notes
standards.where: Banner on DAP · Session Prep private

standards.req: MEMORANDUM heading: TO / FROM / DATE / RE; centered all-caps section titles
Question Presented (names jurisdiction, doesn’t assume the conclusion) → Brief Answer → Facts → Discussion (CRRACC) → Conclusion
standards.where: Office Memo sections; legal analysis left to the attorney

standards.req: Facts objective, favorable and unfavorable, chronological
standards.where: Facts incl. unconfirmed voicemail flagged as unfavorable

standards.req: Potential-new-client screening: source, reason, prior counsel, goals, conflict check, documents to bring
Consultation checklist: facts, critical issues, fees, retainer, scope, process, chronology, known/unknown facts, witnesses & documents, review notes
standards.where: Live coverage chips while recording · Review → Checklist

standards.req: Versioning, approval, monitoring and audit of procedures
standards.where: Output Studio draft → test → publish · version history · Audit

diffs.d: Competitors are vertical. Verity shares the capture and evidence engine, with separate templates and safety rules per profession.
Source-linked, verified, needs review, explicitly denied, not documented. Approval is blocked until flagged items are resolved.
Draft → test against a sample session → validation report → publish a version. Published changes never alter approved documents.
Nabla offers it; we deliberately don’t. Verity documents what was said and doesn’t suggest diagnoses or legal conclusions.
Liquid Glass Mac app with an iPhone companion and Handoff, instead of a browser tab.

gaps.d: Suitability language, risk-tolerance changes, beneficiary flags, and archiving to compliance systems (Jump/Zocks territory).
One note per member with separate access (Mentalyc has this).
Abridge and Dragon Copilot live inside Epic; we push approved documents into it.
Compare an intake interview with a later deposition (Clio Work).
Pre-bill coding review is moving into scribes (Abridge).

pricing.note: Freed, Heidi, Nabla — free tiers are common
